messages:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT: Autoscaler in ap-south1 reporting repeated 'quota_exceeded' errors for GPU resources. Queue length for inference-pool-ap-south1 > 1200 requests/min and growing. Trigger: autoscaler/failures/quotahit. incident-bot: Pager sent to #incidents and on-call.

maya (oncall): I'm on it. Confirming impact: are requests being throttled or are they stuck in queue? :ambulance:

sam (eng-sre): throttled + queueing. We started seeing error 429 from the nodegroup controller at 21:02 UTC. Metrics: 95th latency up from 120ms -> 2.1s over past 10m. Token-processing backlog up ~18k tokens/min aggregated. Logs:
```
autoscaler: failed to create instance: Quota 'NVIDIA_TESLA_A100' exceeded in region asia-south1
request id: x-req-98321
```

sam (eng-sre): This is GCP quota, not internal capacity. Autoscaler keeps trying but API is returning quota_exceeded. No healthy spare capacity to fall back to in-region.

lee (infra): I've opened an urgent GCP support case and requested quota bump. Case: 1754321. ETA from GCP support is unknown, but I flagged P0 and asked for a temporary increase. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas?project=redwood-prod

maya (oncall): Can we route traffic to another region while this is ongoing? Are model variants available in eu-west1 / us-central1?

sam (eng-sre): Yes — we have compatible model variants in eu-west1 and us-central1. Plan options:
1) Failover routing: send new requests to eu-west1 (adds ~120ms extra latency) — quick config change in routing layer.
2) Spin up smaller GPU instances (T4/1x) in ap-south1 that are within quota but fewer tokens/sec — would reduce capacity but avoid cross-region latency.
3) Serve degraded mode: enable cached responses for known prefixes and throttle non-critical bulk jobs.

maya (oncall): Prioritize customer-facing low-latency traffic -> route to eu-west1. Sam, can you do a canary redirect for 10% now and 100% if stable?

sam (eng-sre): Doing canary. Command I'm running:
```
rbxctl routes update --route inference-prod --region-fallback eu-west1 --canary 10
```
I'll post results in 2 minutes.

deploy-bot: reroute job started by sam at 21:05 UTC. rollout id: r-2101234567-1. Monitoring channels: #rt-metrics.

sam (eng-sre): Canary looks good. Error rate for routed requests is stable and queue drain in ap-south1 started to slow down (requests still queued but growth stopped). Increasing canary to 100% now.

deploy-bot: reroute completed to eu-west1 at 21:09 UTC. rollout id: r-2101234567-1 -> status: success.

ana (product): Customer impact assessment: We have two customers (AcmeAI, Tutorly) reporting elevated errors in ap-south1 since 20:58 UTC. Their traffic has been redirected; latency increase ~120ms for them. Any large batch jobs affected? If so, we should throttle them.

rachel (cs): Reaching out to AcmeAI and Tutorly with a heads-up: short region failover to eu-west1, slight latency bump. Drafting message:
"Hi — we're experiencing a regional GPU provisioning issue in ap-south1 causing a brief failover to eu-west1. Your requests are being served from eu-west1 with an additional ~120ms latency. No data lost. We're working on restoring ap-south1 and will update you by EOD." Thoughts?

maya (oncall): Good. Post that now and add that we're tracking a quota increase request with GCP.

lee (infra): For temporary capacity, I can also try to create smaller-node MIGs that use T4 quotas we still have. Quick plan:
- Create a 4-node T4 pool, attach to inference workload with lower batch sizes.
- Update autoscaler to prefer dedicated pool when available.

sam (eng-sre): Be careful with model memory/compatibility; some large models need A100. We'll only put lightweight models on the T4 pool. I'll add a routing rule to exclude large-model routes.

maya (oncall): Assigning incident role: I will be incident commander until 22:00 UTC. Sam -> mitigation lead. Lee -> infra lead. Ana -> customer comms. Rachel -> customer contact. Keep updates every 10m.

(10m pass)

sam (eng-sre): Update 21:20 UTC: queue length in ap-south1 down 60% after failover. Error rate normalized. GCP support replied: "We've escalated; provisional increase possible within 2-6 hours" — no hard ETA. They requested exact quota numbers and usage history; Lee sent that.

lee (infra): GCP accepted a temporary soft increase of 8 A100 GPUs for the project but it won't show in API until they provision it. Ticket updated: 1754321 -> status: monitoring. Also submitted a request for permanent increase.

maya (oncall): We'll keep eu-west1 as active until we see A100 capacity restored. Plan P0-1: keep routing fallback for 3 hours, then reassess. Any regression on eu-west1? Sam?

sam (eng-sre): eu-west1 stable. However, note cost delta — mention to finance post-incident. Also observed some long-tail token queues for large-model routes that couldn't be moved; those requests returned 429 until we enabled degraded-mode cache.

ana (product): Logging action item: evaluate multi-region model placement to avoid single-region quota exposure. Add to postmortem.

rachel (cs): Update to customers sent. Response from AcmeAI: "Thanks for the update — please let us know when ap-south1 is back, the 120ms is fine." :thumbsup:

maya (oncall): Handoff at 22:00 UTC: on-call next is sam. I'll brief him: autoscaler hit GCP A100 quota in ap-south1, routing to eu-west1, temporary 8 A100 soft increase pending, T4 fallback pool possible. Sam, you're IC now.

sam (eng-sre): Acknowledged. I'll monitor until we resolve and start the postmortem draft. Major action items:
- Confirm GCP permanent quota increase (lee) -- owner: lee
- Add model placement multi-region policy (ana)
- Add alert tuning: detect region-level quota_exceeded events earlier (maya/sam)
- Customer communications summary (rachel)

deploy-bot: incident thread closed by maya at 22:01 UTC. Please re-open if needed.

maya (oncall): Thanks all. Good job. :clap:
